overview: "هری استریت" نویسنده ای است که در سفری به کوههای کلیمانجارو بر اثر عفونتی در حال مرگ زندگی خود را دورباره مرور می کند و...
overview_en: The story centers on the memories of a writer (Gregory Peck) who is taking a safari in Africa. He develops a dangerous wound from a thorn prick, and lies awaiting his slow death. The loss of physical capability causes him to look inside himself - at his memories of the past years, and how little he has actually accomplished in his writing.
